mechanics.acquisition: Parallel Quest 175 — Who's the Next Leader?!
mechanics.behavior: User dashes forward inside a ring of energy. Base use costs 100 Ki and hits up to 11 times; holding the input can spend up to 200 additional Ki for a longer sequence, up to 30 hits total, ending in a short-range knockback shockwave.
mechanics.reward: Current evidence identifies PQ175 as the acquisition endpoint; maintained repository data records the 50% Ultimate Finish reward route.
